* '''PC-E1''' ([[Supremacy: Throne Room (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). '''Dark Side:''' Once per game, may deploy Snoke here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Supremacy: Throne Room]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Supremacy: Throne Room]] (published 8 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Supremacy: Throne Room”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
